feed.title: enterpriseai.tools weekly updates — assistants
feed.subtitle: High-impact market intelligence for enterprise AI tooling, with an expandable release log for lower-signal product changes.

entry.title: Genie ZeroOps is available in beta
entry.summary: Databricks Genie ZeroOps, in beta, runs in the background to watch jobs, pipelines and tables, detects failures and data quality issues, finds root causes and proposes fixes.

entry.title: Genie One connects to Claude, ChatGPT and Cursor
entry.summary: Databricks added Genie plugins and a connector so Claude, ChatGPT and Cursor (listed as Grok Bot/Cursor) users can query their data through Genie One, with each user signing in with a Databricks account.

entry.title: Anthropic launches its IPO roadshow
entry.summary: Anthropic began the roadshow for its proposed IPO on November 10, 2026: 825 million Class A shares at $70 to $78 each, to list on the Nasdaq Global Select Market as ANT. The registration statement is not yet effective.

source.title: Anthropic launches roadshow for proposed initial public offering

entry.title: Gemini 4 Carbon is generally available in Copilot
entry.summary: Gemini 4 Carbon is generally available in Copilot, rolling out to Pro+, Max, Business and Enterprise and billed at provider list pricing under usage-based billing.

entry.title: GitHub Apps can manage enterprise Copilot seats
entry.summary: Enterprise GitHub Apps can now use the enterprise Copilot seat management APIs through a new fine-grained permission, controlling which users and enterprise teams receive Copilot seats.

source.title: GitHub App support for Enterprise Copilot seat management

entry.title: Kiro Enterprise Management enters preview
entry.summary: Kiro Enterprise Management, in preview, lets admins write one policy in the AWS console for the IDE, CLI, Web and Crew LTS. It covers new profiles in US East (N. Virginia) with IAM Identity Center, Okta or Entra ID.

entry.title: Gemini 4 Carbon GA in Gemini Enterprise
entry.summary: Gemini 4 Carbon is generally available in the Gemini Enterprise web and mobile apps, Workflow Builder and AI developer tools in the global, us and eu multi-regions. It is off by default in the apps.

entry.title: Anthropic releases Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2
entry.summary: Claude Fable 5.2 is available to all users at $8/$40 per million input/output tokens, including on AWS, Google Cloud and Azure. Mythos 5.2 is limited to vetted organizations, but Claude Enterprise customers can use it through Claude Security.

source.title: Introducing Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2

entry.title: Claude Code 2.1.321 fixes MCP OAuth and sandbox flaws
entry.summary: Claude Code 2.1.321 makes Claude Fable 5.2 the default Fable model. It fixes MCP OAuth requests sending refresh tokens to another host after a redirect, and a read-only Bash command running outside the sandbox without a prompt.

entry.title: Genie Ontology and Genie Search are generally available
entry.summary: Genie Ontology, the business-context layer for Genie agents, and Genie Search are generally available. Search indexes sources such as Google Drive, Jira, Confluence and Workday while keeping source document permissions.

entry.title: Claude Fable 5.2 is generally available in Copilot
entry.summary: Claude Fable 5.2 is generally available in Copilot, rolling out to Pro+, Max, Business and Enterprise. Business and Enterprise admins must enable its model policy, which is off by default.

entry.title: Claude Code 2.1.319 fixes permission-check bypasses
entry.summary: Claude Code 2.1.319 fixes a Bash permission bypass where a crafted environment prefix could hide part of a command, a sed command skipping checks in accept-edits and auto mode, and a sandbox escape when creating a worktree.

entry.title: Codex CLI 0.167 adds an agent command center
entry.summary: Codex CLI 0.167.0 adds codex agents --no-daemon, a terminal backend picker, a Google Cloud Vertex AI setup wizard and opt-in system proxy support. 0.167.2 (November 11, 2026) sends tool updates incrementally on Vertex AI by default.

entry.title: @GitHub in Slack and Teams is generally available
entry.summary: @GitHub in Slack and Microsoft Teams is generally available, letting users investigate bugs, create issues, implement changes and open pull requests from chat.

source.title: @GitHub in Slack and Teams is generally available

entry.title: Copilot code review settings get REST and GraphQL APIs
entry.summary: Copilot code review settings can be managed through REST and GraphQL from enterprise policy down to repositories. Enterprise and organization endpoints do not support GitHub Apps or fine-grained tokens.

source.title: Copilot code review API management and review overview updates

entry.title: Gemini Code Assist bundled entitlement ends March 31, 2027
entry.summary: Gemini Code Assist entitlements bundled with existing Gemini Enterprise Standard and Plus subscriptions end on March 31, 2027, with support limited to Gemini 3.x until then. Subscriptions from October 9, 2026 no longer include it.

entry.title: Claude Enterprise adds a security center and inference hooks
entry.summary: Inference hooks (prompt and pre-tool-call) are generally available for Claude Enterprise. A security center, centralized management, a self-serve IP allowlist and EDR in Cowork on macOS and Windows are in beta.

source.title: More visibility and control over Claude Enterprise for security teams

entry.title: Cursor adds Live Apps with admin publish controls
entry.summary: Cursor cloud agents can now build web apps with a database, auth and hosting. Publishing runs security checks first, and team admins can view apps and secrets and approve or unpublish them.

entry.title: Q Developer in the AWS console becomes the AWS assistant
entry.summary: AWS renamed Amazon Q Developer in the Management Console and Console Mobile Apps to the AWS assistant, offered free and globally; Pro subscribers keep their Pro Tier capabilities. The post does not mention the IDE or CLI.

source.title: Amazon Q Developer in console is now the AWS assistant

entry.title: Gemini Enterprise adds prepaid credits
entry.summary: Prepaid credits are generally available for self-serve billing accounts, covering pay-as-you-go and over-quota usage in the Gemini Enterprise app, Agent Platform and AI developer tools. Usage stops at a zero balance.

entry.title: Claude Haiku 5.5 and Kimi K3 GA in Kiro
entry.summary: Claude Haiku 5.5 and Kimi K3 are generally available in Kiro across the IDE, CLI, Crew and Web. The indemnity exclusion no longer applies to Haiku 5.5, but Kimi K3 remains an Excluded Model.

source.title: Claude Haiku 5.5 and Kimi K3 generally available

entry.title: Kiro CLI 3.0 makes V3 the default and retires Classic
entry.summary: Kiro CLI 3.0.0 makes V3 the default agent harness for interactive sessions. The Classic (V1) interface, the desktop app and inline shell autocomplete are retired; running kiro-cli --v2 keeps the V2 agent.

entry.title: Kiro brings Claude Haiku 5.5 to AWS GovCloud (US)
entry.summary: Claude Haiku 5.5 is available in the Kiro IDE and CLI in the AWS GovCloud (US) Regions, so all three Claude 5.5 models (Opus, Sonnet and Haiku) are now offered there.

source.title: Haiku 5.5 now available on Kiro in AWS GovCloud (US)

entry.title: Claude Code deprecates fast mode for Opus 4.8
entry.summary: Claude Code 2.1.316 deprecates fast mode for Claude Opus 4.8, effective October 30, 2026, with removal on November 30, 2026. Anthropic points users to Opus 5.5. The same release adds pooled group budgets to the Claude apps gateway.

entry.title: Claude Opus 5.5 and GPT-5.6 Sol GA in Kiro
entry.summary: Claude Opus 5.5 and GPT-5.6 Sol are generally available in Kiro. Experimental labels are removed and the Kiro Excluded Models indemnity exception no longer applies to them; plans, regions and multipliers are unchanged.

source.title: Claude Opus 5.5 and GPT-5.6 Sol Generally Available

entry.title: GitHub Copilot SDK is becoming Microsoft Copilot SDK
entry.summary: GitHub is renaming the Copilot SDK to Microsoft Copilot SDK, the interface to the shared Microsoft Copilot harness, and moving its repository to the Microsoft organization in phases. No action is needed yet; package names may still say GitHub.

source.title: GitHub Copilot SDK is becoming Microsoft Copilot SDK

entry.title: GitHub Enterprise can include Copilot for every user
entry.summary: Through an account team, GitHub Enterprise Cloud can now include Copilot for every licensed user, with AI usage metered against the enterprise budget instead of seats. Copilot Standalone costs $10 per user per month. Self-serve access comes later.

source.title: GitHub Enterprise now includes access to GitHub Copilot

entry.title: Copilot cloud sessions are generally available
entry.summary: Connected Copilot cloud sessions are generally available on paid plans. They run in GitHub-managed sandboxes and continue across github.com, mobile, CLI, VS Code, Slack and Teams. Sandbox billing starts in November 2026, and the Actions entitlement becomes a shared dollar pool.

source.title: Work from anywhere with a new, connected Copilot cloud experience

entry.title: Copilot Fusion multi-model routing is generally available
entry.summary: Copilot Fusion is generally available. It routes and orchestrates tasks across models, with Standard, High and Max effort levels. Each model is billed at its own rate, with a limited-time 30% discount, and admins can restrict which models it uses.

source.title: Route and orchestrate models with GitHub Copilot Fusion

entry.title: Copilot enterprise plugin controls are generally available
entry.summary: Admins can approve plugin marketplaces, require some plugins and block others across VS Code, Copilot CLI and the Copilot app. Enterprise controls need GitHub Enterprise Cloud plus Copilot Business or Enterprise.

source.title: Repository plugin defaults and enterprise plugin controls generally available

entry.title: Copilot code review adds Max level and PR approvals
entry.summary: Copilot code review adds a Max level in public preview that runs several review agents across providers. Copilot approvals are generally available, off by default and path-limited, and count toward required approvals.

source.title: Copilot code review: Merge with confidence with Max and approvals

entry.title: GitHub Agentic Workflows is generally available
entry.summary: GitHub Agentic Workflows lets teams define agent automations in Markdown that compile to Actions YAML, with read-only default permissions and a threat-detection job. The default engine needs a Copilot license.

entry.title: Gemini Enterprise opens an in-country region in Brazil
entry.summary: Gemini Enterprise is generally available, with an allowlist, in a Brazil (br) region that keeps data residency and ML processing in-country.

entry.title: GSA deal gives US agencies 40% off Claude Enterprise
entry.summary: A new GSA agreement gives government buyers 40% off Claude Enterprise, Claude for Government and the Claude API, including state and local governments. Claude Enterprise is in process for FedRAMP Moderate through FedRAMP 20x.

entry.title: Codex CLI adds a built-in Vertex AI provider
entry.summary: Codex CLI 0.165.0 adds a built-in Google Cloud Vertex AI provider, puts GPT-6.1 Terra in its model catalogs and turns on Memory v2 by default for new profiles. 0.166.0 (October 29, 2026) adds Terra to the Vertex AI and Bedrock catalogs.

entry.title: Copilot SDK server-to-server authentication in preview
entry.summary: In public preview, services built on the Copilot SDK can call Copilot with an installed GitHub App's organization identity. Usage is billed to that organization, and its model policies and budgets apply.

entry.title: Admins can deploy custom MCP connectors in Microsoft 365
entry.summary: Per the October 27, 2026 release notes, admins can create custom MCP connectors in the Microsoft 365 admin center and deploy them across the organization to bring proprietary data into Copilot.

entry.title: Work IQ APIs move to usage-based billing
entry.summary: Per the October 27, 2026 release notes, developers can call Work IQ agents and models without pre-assigned licenses, billed per API request based on the agents and models invoked.

entry.title: Custom MCP servers get VPC connectivity in Gemini Enterprise
entry.summary: Custom MCP server data stores in Gemini Enterprise gain generally available VPC connectivity and static IP egress through Agent Gateway.

entry.title: Anthropic files S-1 for a proposed IPO
entry.summary: Anthropic filed a Form S-1 with the SEC on October 26, 2026 for a proposed IPO of Class A common stock on the Nasdaq Global Select Market under the ticker ANT. The number of shares and the price range have not been set.

source.title: Anthropic files S-1 with the SEC

entry.title: GPT-6.1 Terra arrives in ChatGPT Work for Enterprise
entry.summary: OpenAI made GPT-6.1 Terra available on October 26, 2026 in ChatGPT Work and Codex on Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise and Edu plans. It is not available in Chat and does not support UAE inference residency.

entry.title: GPT-6.1 Terra is generally available in Copilot
entry.summary: GPT-6.1 Terra is generally available in Copilot on Pro, Pro+, Max, Business and Enterprise plans, rolling out gradually and billed at provider list pricing under usage-based billing.

entry.title: Devin Desktop overhauls its Agent Window
entry.summary: Devin Desktop v3.11.212 aligns the Agent Window with the Devin web app, adding side-by-side sessions, Files and Changes views and a terminal per session. Agent diff zones and auto-opening of edited files are now off by default.

entry.title: Antigravity Enterprise Gateway is generally available
entry.summary: Organizations can route Antigravity app, CLI and IDE extension model requests through a central gateway for inspection, policy enforcement and gateway API-key authentication. These requests use pay-as-you-go billing, not seat quotas.

entry.title: Gemini for government services enters preview
entry.summary: Google announced Gemini for government services in preview, built on the Gemini agent and deployable inside the Assured Workloads FedRAMP High data boundary with VPC Service Controls and CMEK. No product-wide authorization status is stated.

entry.title: Copilot deprecates six models
entry.summary: GitHub deprecated Gemini 3.7 Flash, GPT-5.5, GPT-5.4, GPT-5.4 mini, GPT-5 mini and Grok 4.5 across Copilot on October 19, 2026. Suggested replacements are Gemini 3.8 Flash, GPT-6.1 Sol, GPT-6 Luna and Grok 4.7.

source.title: GitHub Copilot models deprecated on October 19, 2026

entry.title: Copilot model policy API is generally available
entry.summary: REST endpoints to read and set Copilot model policies are GA at enterprise, enterprise-team, agent-app and organization level. Enterprise policy can delegate model control to organizations or to teams and apps.

source.title: Copilot model policy API for enterprise, orgs, and teams

entry.title: Kiro adds Memory and CLI workspace trust
entry.summary: Kiro IDE 1.4.0 (October 19, 2026) adds Memory across chat sessions, and IDE 1.4.10 (October 20) turns it off by default. Kiro CLI 2.33.0 (October 20) asks users to trust a folder before loading its hooks, agents and MCP servers.

entry.title: Copilot to retire Claude Opus 4.8, Opus 5 and GPT-5.6 Terra
entry.summary: GitHub will deprecate Claude Opus 4.8, Claude Opus 5 and GPT-5.6 Terra across Copilot on November 16, 2026, pointing to Claude Opus 5.5, GPT-6.1 Sol or GPT-6 Luna. Opus 4.8 stays available to individual annual-plan subscribers.

source.title: Upcoming deprecation of selected GitHub Copilot models in mid-November

entry.title: Agentic autofix for code scanning alerts is GA
entry.summary: Assigning a code scanning alert to Copilot now produces a validated fix as a draft pull request. It needs GitHub Code Security or Advanced Security on Enterprise Cloud, uses AI Credits and Actions minutes, and must be enabled by admin policy.

source.title: Agentic autofix for code scanning alerts general availability

entry.title: Kimi K3 added to Kiro (experimental)
entry.summary: Kimi K3 is available in Kiro with experimental support for Pro, Pro+, Pro Max and Power customers in the US geography, at a 2.4x credit multiplier.

entry.title: Claude Opus 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5 GA in Gemini Enterprise
entry.summary: Admins can make Claude Opus 5.5 and Claude Sonnet 5.5 available in the Gemini Enterprise app (global, us and eu locations) by enabling third-party models; usage is billed pay-as-you-go.

entry.title: Genie Code SQL converter is generally available
entry.summary: The agentic code converter powered by Genie Code is GA for SQL, converting T-SQL, Snowflake, Redshift, Oracle, BigQuery and Teradata dialects to Databricks SQL and validating the output.

entry.title: Claude Sonnet 4 reaches end of life in Kiro
entry.summary: Claude Sonnet 4 reached end of life in Kiro on October 14, 2026; users relying on it need to switch models. Claude Sonnet 5.5 is the latest Sonnet in Kiro.

entry.title: GPT-5.5 retired in Codex for ChatGPT sign-in
entry.summary: GPT-5.5 is no longer available in Codex for users signed in with ChatGPT; API-key sessions are unaffected. OpenAI points users to gpt-6.1-sol and says to update saved configs, agents and scheduled tasks.

entry.title: Gemini 4 Argon is generally available in Copilot
entry.summary: Gemini 4 Argon is GA for Copilot Pro+, Max, Business and Enterprise with a gradual rollout. Business and Enterprise admins control it through model policy; billing is usage-based at provider list pricing.

entry.title: Copilot clients can fail closed on stale policy
entry.summary: Enterprise admins can set forceRemoteSettingsRefresh so Copilot CLI, VS Code and the Copilot app fail closed when they cannot confirm current policy. The sandbox key now enforces a minimum client version.

entry.title: Gemini 4 Argon GA in Gemini Enterprise
entry.summary: Gemini 4 Argon is GA in the Gemini Enterprise web app (off by default until October 27, 2026), mobile app and AI developer tools, and in Workflow Builder from October 14. Gemini 3.8 Flash also became GA in the UK region on October 14.

entry.title: Gemini Code Assist — deprecation
entry.summary: Google stopped selling new Gemini Code Assist Standard and Enterprise subscriptions on October 9, 2026. Existing subscriptions auto-renew through 2026, auto-renewal ends in 2027, and Google points customers to Antigravity.

source.title: Gemini for Google Cloud release notes

entry.title: OpenAI Codex — feature
entry.summary: Codex added GPT-6.1 Sol Ultrafast mode for Pro and eligible Enterprise and Edu plans. It is off by default for Enterprise and supports US and EEA/Switzerland inference residency.

entry.title: ChatGPT Enterprise — feature
entry.summary: GPT-6.1 Sol Ultrafast mode is available for eligible ChatGPT Enterprise workspaces. It is off by default and workspace owners must enable it.

entry.title: Gemini Enterprise — model-addition
entry.summary: Gemini Enterprise admins can enable Claude Opus 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5 for Antigravity tools. They are off by default and billed as consumption with overages enabled.

entry.title: GitHub Copilot — model-addition
entry.summary: Claude Haiku 5.5 is generally available in GitHub Copilot for Pro, Pro+, Max, Business and Enterprise.

entry.title: GitHub Copilot — feature
entry.summary: Local sandboxing is generally available in Copilot CLI, the Copilot app and VS Code Agent Host sessions at no extra cost, with enterprise policies developers cannot weaken.

source.title: Local sandboxing for GitHub Copilot now generally available

entry.title: Claude Code — model-addition
entry.summary: Claude Code 2.1.293 made Claude Haiku 5.5 (1M context) the default Haiku model on the Anthropic API.

entry.title: Claude Enterprise — model-addition
entry.summary: Anthropic released Claude Haiku 5.5, available on all Claude plans including Enterprise.

entry.title: Google Antigravity — feature
entry.summary: Antigravity 2.21.1 renamed Scheduled Tasks to Automations and added search across conversations.

entry.title: Gemini Enterprise — feature
entry.summary: Gemini Enterprise added admin controls for Antigravity: Boost is generally available and Teamwork is in Preview.

entry.title: Databricks Genie Code — release
entry.summary: Genie Code CLI entered Beta as a terminal coding agent for data and AI work, with model access governed through Unity Gateway.

entry.title: Microsoft 365 Copilot — feature
entry.summary: Microsoft 365 Copilot added Copilot Search with embedded chat, a switch-model option, custom skills in PowerPoint and Cowork adoption metrics in Viva Insights.

entry.title: Cursor — feature
entry.summary: Cursor added remote control of local agents from its iOS app. It is on by default except in Enterprise orgs, where admins must enable it.

entry.title: GitHub Copilot — deprecation
entry.summary: GitHub deprecated Gemini 3.5 Flash, Gemini 3.6 Flash, Kimi K2.7 Code and Claude Opus 4.7 across Copilot; suggested replacements are Gemini 3.8 Flash, Kimi K3 and Claude Opus 5.5.

source.title: Selected models in GitHub Copilot deprecated

entry.title: Kiro — model-addition
entry.summary: Kiro added experimental Claude Sonnet 5.5 support with a 1M-token context window across the IDE, CLI and Web.

entry.title: Gemini Enterprise — feature
entry.summary: Gemini Enterprise federated query mode (Preview) queries AlloyDB, BigQuery, Cloud SQL and Spanner data in place through MCP using each user’s credentials.

entry.title: Gemini Enterprise — deprecation
entry.summary: Gemini 2.5 Pro will be removed from the Gemini Enterprise app in the Canada and Japan in-country regions on October 20, 2026; it stays in global, US and EU.

entry.title: Kiro — feature
entry.summary: Kiro introduced multi-agent Workflows across the CLI, IDE and Web cloud sessions.

entry.title: GitHub Copilot — model-addition
entry.summary: Claude Opus 5.5 became selectable in GitHub Copilot for Pro+, Max, Business, and Enterprise plans across IDEs, GitHub.com, Copilot CLI, and the coding agent.

source.title: Claude Opus 5.5 is now available in GitHub Copilot · GitHub Changelog

entry.title: GitHub Copilot — feature
entry.summary: GitHub Copilot added Jira-to-implementation context in the Copilot app, experimental adaptive model routing in Copilot CLI, recurring agent automations in VS Code, and centrally managed JetBrains sandbox policies.

entry.title: Cursor — feature
entry.summary: Cursor launched Projects in beta for long-lived bodies of work, with a coordinator that delegates to parallel cloud and local agents, shared project context, and scheduled or event-driven subscriptions.

entry.title: Cursor — feature
entry.summary: Cursor now states that it holds ISO/IEC 27001:2022 and ISO/IEC 42001:2023 certifications, alongside its SOC 2 Type II attestation and AIUC-1 certification.

source.title: Certifications and third-party assessments · Cursor Security

entry.title: SpaceX completes its acquisition of Cursor
entry.summary: Cursor announced on August 14, 2026 that it has officially been acquired by SpaceX, completing a process that began with a partnership in April 2026. Cursor says it will gain large GPU compute for model training; no pricing or plan changes were announced.

source.title: Cursor is now a part of SpaceX

entry.title: Amazon Q Business — deprecation
entry.summary: Amazon Q Business closed to new customers; AWS will continue bug fixes and security updates for existing customers but will not consider new feature requests, and recommends migration to Amazon Quick.

entry.title: Databricks Genie Agents — rename
entry.summary: Databricks renamed Genie Spaces to Genie Agents and moved Genie to pay-as-you-go billing with 150 free DBUs of LLM usage per month.

entry.title: Gemini Code Assist — deprecation
entry.summary: Gemini Code Assist stopped serving the individuals, Google AI Pro, and Google AI Ultra tiers; those users are directed to Antigravity, leaving Standard and Enterprise editions.

source.title: Gemini Code Assist overview · Google Cloud

entry.title: Devin Desktop — rename
entry.summary: Cognition renamed the Windsurf editor to Devin Desktop, keeping plans, settings, and extensions, and made an Agent Command Center the default surface.

source.title: Windsurf is now Devin Desktop · Devin

entry.title: Amazon Q Developer — deprecation
entry.summary: AWS announced end of support for Amazon Q Developer IDE plugins and paid subscriptions on April 30, 2027, blocked new signups from May 15, 2026, and recommended Kiro.

source.title: Amazon Q Developer end-of-support announcement · AWS DevOps Blog

entry.title: GitHub Copilot expands model-training use of interaction data
entry.summary: GitHub announced that, from April 24, interaction data from Copilot Free, Pro, and Pro+ users will be used for model improvement unless users opt out, making data-governance review more important for enterprises.

source.title: Updates to GitHub Copilot interaction data usage policy
